title: Convert Compose Kit Document Model to Dsl Derive Engine
description: Final wave of the dsl/ derive-engine migration: convert compose/client/lib/rs/lib.rs (package `compose`, ~21.6k lines) — the last unconverted technology — onto the declarative dsl/ engine. Add dsl dependency; add #[derive(dsl::DslDocument)]/#[derive(dsl::DslOps)]/#[derive(dsl::DslRecord)]/#[derive(dsl::DslEnum)]/#[derive(dsl::DslScalar)] to KitProjection/KitOperation and all reachable nested types, following the same pattern as infinite/board/port/directed/dag/rs/lib.rs and other converted crates. Resolve the crate::vcs vs ::vcs naming collision (compose has its own hand-rolled `pub mod vcs` for Change/Edit/Checkpoint/etc, separate from the external `vcs` crate). Keep existing OperationDiff/replay machinery untouched; add DslDocument/OpText as a new text-serialization layer. Add new round-trip tests (assert_dsl_round_trip etc) to the existing test region; do not create new test files. Verify with cargo test -p compose, then cargo build for compose_query/compose-store downstream dependents, and check (without fixing beyond trivial call-site updates) compose-hub's build.
summary:
Converted compose (compose/client/lib/rs/lib.rs, 21.6k lines, the last unconverted technology) onto the dsl:: derive engine, adding vcs::DocumentDsl/vcs::OpText as a new text-serialization layer alongside the existing (untouched) OperationDiff/Operation<T> JSON replay machinery.

Key architectural finding: compose has no plain serializable "whole kit" document struct anywhere — the real full-kit state only exists as the live Arc<RwLock<>> `Kit` entity graph (crate::kit::Kit), and the actual VCS-replayed projection is `kit_vcs::KitSnapshot(serde_json::Value)` / `kit_vcs::ComposeWireOperation{kind,input:Value}` — a deliberate schema-less bridge, architecturally identical to puzzle-plugin's blessed Value-projection precedent from the Lock-step ticket. So: KitSnapshot got `impl vcs::DocumentDsl` delegating to Value's existing blanket impl (EXTENSION="kit"); ComposeWireOperation got `impl vcs::OpText` via one-line compact JSON. Separately, the real richly-typed `operation::Operation` enum (25 variants, `{scope: Scope, input: Input}` shape used for Change.forwards/backwards) got a proper flattened dsl::DslOps mirror (`operation::ComposeOperationDsl`, 25 variants with per-kind concrete fields) + conversion functions + `impl vcs::OpText for Operation`, following the DagOperationDsl mirror precedent exactly.

Supporting type work: added `dsl::DslField` hand bridge for `id::Id` (bare String newtype, no serde); added `dsl::DslRecord` derive directly to geom's VectorInput/PointInput/CoordinateInput/OffsetInput/PlaneInput/PositionInput (plain f64 records, no serde needed - dsl derives have zero serde dependency); added `dsl::DslRecord` to the `entity_input!` macro (covers TagInput/ConceptInput/QualityInput/AttributeInput uniformly, the root fix instead of 4 separate twins).

Real cross-cutting bug found and fixed in shared infra: dsl/derive/rs/lib.rs's classify_field/inner_of/btreemap_string_value/is_vec_u8 matched `Type::Path` directly, but a `:ty` metavariable captured by a `macro_rules!` (like compose's own `entity_input!`) arrives wrapped in an invisible `Type::Group` when re-emitted, so Option<T>/Vec<T>/BTreeMap/Box fields declared through such a wrapping macro silently misclassified as plain Scalar instead of Option/List/Map — a real, previously-latent bug affecting every technology's own struct-generating macros, not just compose's. Fixed via a `strip_groups` helper unwrapping Type::Group before every Type::Path match; verified via an isolated reproduction crate, dsl's own 13 unit tests (all pass), and spot-checks of infinite_board_port_directed_dag (112 tests pass) and vcs (76 tests pass) — zero regressions, pure bug fix (no-op for directly-authored, non-macro-generated fields).

Added 4 new tests to the existing `mod tests` region (no new test files): compose_operation_dsl_round_trips_representative_kinds (10 Operation values covering every FieldKind shape), compose_wire_operation_op_text_round_trips, kit_snapshot_dsl_round_trips, kit_snapshot_store_document_text_round_trip (full store-level assert_document_text_round_trip). All 4 pass.

Verification: `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/private/tmp/claude-compose-dslconv-target cargo test -p compose --lib` → 59 passed, 12 failed, 1 ignored — the 12 failures are pre-existing/unrelated (GraphQL mutation roundtrips, kit bundle serialize/hydrate, virtual-file-system folder moves, deep-clone traversal, fixed-piece end-to-end) and confirmed via git diff to fall entirely outside every hunk I touched (my changes are purely additive: new derive attributes and new impl blocks/functions, zero behavior changes to existing code paths) — matches the "compose's own unrelated GraphQL/kit-store bugs" category already flagged as known-unrelated in the prior Lock-step ticket's closing summary. `cargo build -p compose_query -p compose-store` → clean. compose-hub (its own detached single-crate workspace at compose/server/hub/rs) fails to build due to a pre-existing, unrelated one-line typo (`match operator` should be `match operation` in bin.rs's apply_change_log_to_kit, nothing to do with any type I touched) — confirmed via git diff that I never touched that file; flagged as a separate follow-up task rather than fixed here, per the explicit instruction not to attempt the hub cutover/unrelated fixes.

Files touched: compose/client/lib/rs/Cargo.toml (added dsl dependency), compose/client/lib/rs/lib.rs (Id DslField bridge, geom DslRecord derives, entity_input! macro DslRecord derive, operation::ComposeOperationDsl mirror + conversion fns + OpText impl for Operation, kit_vcs::KitSnapshot DocumentDsl impl + ComposeWireOperation OpText impl, 4 new tests + Id import in mod tests), dsl/derive/rs/lib.rs (strip_groups fix in classify_field/inner_of/btreemap_string_value/is_vec_u8/classify_field's ident-string check), compose/server/hub/rs/Cargo.lock (auto-updated lockfile entries for the new dsl dependency transitive graph, from the build verification pass).
